reason: Adds the note tier's four model-facing tools over the store that landed with note-store.json - note_read (budget 3), note_search (2), note_create (1), note_update (2), none terminal - plus R-55, the read-before-write latch on ReplyGuard. A note is addressed by its TITLE, not an id (spec 16.1): the injected index carries title and description and no id, so an id is unreachable for the model; resolution happens in the tool layer against the standing set, and two standing notes answering to one title REFUSE naming both rather than picking. note_search reads bodies only, since every title is already in the prompt, and a miss writes the negative-cache row the curator later reads. note_create surfaces the domain type's own refusal sentence (no anchor, no closing condition, over-long index entry) rather than swallowing it, so a refused call tells the model what to fix. note_update appends a revision under two guards: R-55 vetoes it unless note_read succeeded for that note this turn, and the compare-and-swap refuses a moved head as unavailable with 'read it again' rather than writing on top. The latch is populated in ReplyGuard._after_tool BELOW both early returns and gated on the tool's own ok status - a read that raised, was cancelled, or answered nothing_found licenses nothing - and consumed in evaluate beside R-2's veto, never in the budget check. Wired through ToolRegistry(notes=, note_workspace=), both defaulting to the honest not-configured state: no store or no workspace answers unavailable, never nothing_found. The composition root does not pass either yet, so in production today all four tools answer unavailable and no code path is reachable by users - dormant, like the store and the <notes> block below it.
